description: Every family of subsets with nonempty finite intersections is contained in an ultrafilter, assuming choice.
signature:
Ultrafilter.exists_ultrafilter_of_finite_inter_nonempty.{u} {α : Type u} (S : Set (Set α))
  (cond : ∀ (T : Finset (Set α)), ↑T ⊆ S → (⋂₀ ↑T).Nonempty) : ∃ F, S ⊆ (↑F).sets
